# Executor

Kind: context · Defined in [`src/view/game.cpp`](../../../src/view/game.cpp) · Scene / prefab name: `null` · Described in `data/core.json`

The host's taskflow thread pool (tf::Executor, an external type emplaced by Game)

## Notes

tf::Executor from taskflow, hardware_concurrency workers named 'Worker <n>' (profile::namedWorkers). Only in dynamical's host registry: worlds and headless runs have none (TerrainColliders then builds inline). Used for chunk generation, terrain collider cells, parallel command recording, worlds' parallel steps.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: AnimalAnimation, ChunkGenerator, Renderer, TerrainColliders, WorldTerrain, animals, terrain, vegetation. Written by: Game. Created by: Game. Destroyed by: —.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [AnimalAnimation](../systems/AnimalAnimation.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick | Optional taskflow executor that evaluates the poses in batches of 16. |
| [ChunkGenerator](../systems/ChunkGenerator.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick | tf::Executor the generation jobs run on (get: must exist) |
| [TerrainColliders](../systems/TerrainColliders.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick (update) | tf::Executor: required cells in parallel, prefetch tasks |
| [WorldTerrain](../systems/WorldTerrain.md) | system | World | **read** | tick (update) | looked up, absent in worlds: cells built inline |
| [Game](../systems/service-Game.md) | service | Host | **write+create** | Game::Game | the host's tf::Executor (hardware_concurrency named workers) |
| [Renderer](../systems/service-Renderer.md) | service | Host | **read** | render | The tf::Executor the desktop and headset command buffers are recorded on, in parallel. |
| [animals](../systems/pass-animals.md) | pass | Host | **read** | request | tf::Executor that loads species on workers. |
| [terrain](../systems/pass-terrain.md) | pass | Host | **read** | loadGround | tf::Executor that decodes the ground textures (a local one when absent). |
| [vegetation](../systems/pass-vegetation.md) | pass | Host | **read** | request | tf::Executor that loads species on workers. |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[AnimalAnimation](../systems/AnimalAnimation.md)**
  - Reads resources/animals/library.json and each species' .json, .bin and .anim on first use.
  - Logs the library's size or absence, and each species that fails to load.
  - Runs taskflow tasks (batches of 16 animals when there are more than 32) and waits for them.
- **[ChunkGenerator](../systems/ChunkGenerator.md)**
  - Up to 16 taskflow silent_async jobs at a time (all pending chunks in deterministic runs), FastNoise2 on worker threads.
  - Blocks the main thread on the jobs in deterministic runs and in finish.
  - Profiler zones Generate chunk, Wait for the chunks; plot Chunk jobs.
- **[Game](../systems/service-Game.md)**
  - Reads and writes ./config.7.json; reads resources/graphics.json and the scene files.
  - Creates the Renderer (Vulkan, SDL window, OpenXR).
  - Creates the host thread pool (tf::Executor).
  - Logs unknown arguments, ignored values, the graphics level and scene errors.
- **[Renderer](../systems/service-Renderer.md)**
  - Creates the window, OpenXR session, Vulkan device and swapchain through Context.
  - Makes Lights, RayScene, ProbeVolume, PlantVolumes (with ray tracing), TreeShade, SoilMaps, ClassicRender, VRRender and the passes (SkyPass first, then the scene's renderer.passes).
  - GPU: per-frame fences and semaphores; one transfer, one compute and one graphics submission a frame; waits on the frame fence in prepare and on device idle in init and finish.
  - Threads: records both targets concurrently on the taskflow executor.
  - Log: 'Renderer : unknown pass <name>' (error).
  - Profiler zones: create lighting and targets, create pass / pipelines <name>, update <pass>, Update, Record, Submit.
- **[TerrainColliders](../systems/TerrainColliders.md)**
  - Creates and destroys static Jolt MeshShape bodies in sorted cell order (deterministic).
  - Taskflow for_each (waited) over new required cells and silent_async prefetch jobs; zone Build collider cell.
  - Reads ./resources/mclookup.bin in preinit (throws when missing).
  - Log warning 'Terrain collider : ...' when Jolt refuses a mesh.
- **[WorldTerrain](../systems/WorldTerrain.md)**
  - Creates and destroys static Jolt MeshShape bodies in the world's PhysicsWorld, in sorted cell order.
  - CPU marching cubes and FastNoise2 sampling on the world's thread.
  - Reads ./resources/mclookup.bin in preinit; log warning on a refused mesh.
- **[animals](../systems/pass-animals.md)**
  - Loads species geometry and textures on taskflow workers; uploads buffers and textures.
  - Writes the skinning matrices of the frame into a mapped storage buffer per frame in flight.
  - With ray tracing records animal_skin.rt.comp.glsl dispatches into the frame's compute command buffer.
  - Logs species loaded and failures, and a warning past 65536 joints in view.
- **[terrain](../systems/pass-terrain.md)**
  - Reads resources/textures/grass.png, rock.jpg and resources/ground/ground.json with its textures, uploads them as texture arrays.
  - Reads, or bakes and writes, ./resources/ground_relief_{mud,stones,sand}.bin and uploads the relief rays.
  - Decodes the ground textures as taskflow tasks and waits for them in the constructor.
  - Logs a warning without ground textures, an info line per relief baked.
  - Records one indirect draw per ready chunk into each target's command buffer.
- **[vegetation](../systems/pass-vegetation.md)**
  - Loads species geometry and textures on taskflow workers (silent_async, 6 at a time); uploads buffers and textures, allocates descriptor sets.
  - Logs each species loaded, errors for species and textures that fail.
  - With ray tracing gives meshes and textures to the rays (RayMeshes).
  - Records the plant draws and the far volume boxes of both targets; the destructor waits for running jobs.
